description: Runs the checks on an order: missing PO number, possible duplicate, unknown customer, past cut-off and line count. Applies the changes the customer's rules call for, writes the summary and flags on the order, and decides whether it is ready, needs a person, or is waiting for information. In shadow mode nothing is confirmed without a person.
